newsitem.title: USA: Quality says CEO to be Hughes Foods CEO.
newsitem.headline: Quality says CEO to be Hughes Foods CEO.

text.p: Quality Food Inc said Friday its current president and chief executive officer Dan Kourkoumelis will become president and chief executive of Hughes Family Markets, a Southern California supermarket chain Quality acquired this year.
Roger Hughes will remain chairman of Hughes. A spokesman said there were no current plans to name a new Quality president and CEO.

The spokesman noted that, Mike Huse, currently vice president of store operations at Quality will assume the new title of senior vice president and chief operating officer, and current Quality chief financial officer Marc Evanger will become senior vice president of administration and finance at Quality. Both Huse and Evanger will report directly to Quality chairman Chris Sinclair.
